decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority extensions are occupied.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the north elevation shall be obscure glazed, be permently fixed  closed below a height of 1.8 metres above finished floor level and shall thereafter be retained  in that form or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of  two storey side extension and single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
